query:
SELECT ds.id, ds.sourceUrl, ds.cardId, ds.lastFetchStatus, c.name as cardName, c.imageUrl 
FROM dataSources ds 
LEFT JOIN cards c ON ds.cardId = c.id 
WHERE ds.sourceUrl LIKE '%123526%';
